svg.title: Vibe-Security Benchmark: headline result
svg.desc: Without security rules 60.4% of security-task outputs contained the targeted vulnerability; with the VibeSec rules 13.2%, a 78% lower rate.
svg.text: Do security rules in the prompt make AI-written code safer?
How often generated code contained the vulnerability its task invites, out of 100 security-sensitive tasks
Each square = 1 in 100 outputs for a security-sensitive task. Filled = the blind judge panel found the targeted vulnerability.
717 generated artifacts · 3 open-weight models · 60 scenarios (web + mobile/desktop) · blind 3-judge LLM panel, calibrated on a 47-item gold set
